author: nico_1562
quote: A 99 for a game that took 13 years to develop and is full of bugs? If it had only taken 3 years, I’d understand, as they wouldn’t have had much time, but 13 years, and it gets a score like that? I’ve been a fan of GTA since the PS2 era, but come on... they give it a 99, even while admitting it’s not perfect? Cyberpunk had bugs too (which I can understand, given it took 4 years to release), yet critics absolutely tore it apart. But I guess since it’s GTA, we just hand it an excellent score!
